passages.provision_quote: For purposes of this section, “fixed magazine” means an ammunition feeding device contained in, or permanently attached to, a firearm in such a manner that the device cannot be removed without disassembly of the firearm action.
passages.note: The chaptered bill text shows the operative definition change that extends the assault-weapon ban to firearms lacking a true fixed magazine.

rows.reasoning: McGuire voted Aye on SB 880 (2015-2016), a single-subject bill that tightens the definition of 'assault weapon' by requiring a true fixed magazine rather than a merely detachable one, extending the existing ban to more semiautomatic rifles and pistols while leaving other firearms untouched. This matches rung 2, 'Ban semi-automatic assault-style weapons, while allowing other firearms,' per the annex's guidance that a bill extending an existing assault-weapons ban to more weapons seats rung 2.
